neighbours.label: the copula or linking word that opens an abstract evaluative predicate after a clausal or abstract subject (whether X ... is a question of, all of ethics is a matter of, deciding Y is dependent on): the hinge of a general claim about a concept, as opposed to 'is' in simple descriptive statements about concrete things
fire: In the end, whether a contract was breached is a question of fact for the jury.
Much of medicine is a matter of balancing risks against benefits.
Whether a given policy counts as fair is dependent on who is asked.
For philosophers, the nature of free will is a problem of definition.
How a society treats its prisoners is a measure of its values.
Choosing between the two theories is largely an issue of taste.
Whether such a test is valid is difficult to establish in advance.
At bottom, all of politics is a process of compromise.
quiet: In the end, the box on the top shelf of the closet was full of old photos.
Much of the garden is covered in moss after the wet winter.
The red car parked outside the bakery is my neighbour's.
For breakfast, the hotel's dining room is open from seven.
The bridge over the river is made of stone and iron.
The house at the end of the lane is painted yellow.
The kettle on the stove is still warm from the morning.
At the moment, the train to the coast is running late.
